title: Ottawa - Byward Market Food Tour
blurb:
Experience the Sights and Tastes of the ByWard Market

Our most popular walking tour!

British Colonel John By’s mission to build the Rideau Canal included planning the area’s first commercial district – the ByWard Market. Your C’est Bon Guide will weave you thru this bustling market zone, sharing stories about its history and special signts, while you discover both local and international eateries loved by locals!
NCLUDED IN YOUR TOUR EXPERIENCE

A Knowledgeable Guide – Hear stories about the ByWard’s rich history and the food traditions born from its evolution. 

Language Choice – Choose an English- or French-speaking guide!

Neighbourhood Sights – Visit the ByWard Market Pavilion, the Ottawa Letters, the York Street Plaza, the Courtyards, the Totem Pole of Canada, and more!
